title: Microsoft Purview DSPM: item-level investigation and remediation of overshared SharePoint items in data risk assessments (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: the Entra permissions path omits the Add a permission step needed to reach Microsoft Graph application permissions. The Graph endpoint flagged by the pre-check is valid; the briefing also needs to acknowledge Microsoft's differing role guidance and narrow an unsupported description of DSPM's previous capabilities.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Cloud Application Administrator, Application Administrator or Privileged Role Administrator is the role guidance for configuring and consenting to the app permissions.

claims.fix: Add: 'The DSPM prerequisites list these three roles, but the Graph API reference identifies Privileged Role Administrator as the least-privileged supported role for granting Microsoft Graph app roles.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/serviceprincipal-post-approleassignedto, which states 'Privileged Role Administrator - the least privileged role supported for Microsoft Graph and Azure AD Graph app roles'.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: API permissions leads directly to Microsoft APIs > Microsoft Graph > Application permissions without selecting Add a permission.

claims.fix: Replace the path in controls[0].ui and the rendered table with 'Entra ID > App registrations > app > API permissions > Add a permission > Microsoft Graph > Application permissions'. Set its docs URL to https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity-platform/quickstart-configure-app-access-web-apis and add that page to sources. The existing path omits a required button in the middle.
